definition_english: Describing a physical condition, structural difficulty, or recurring social or economic problem—such as rent-collection failure, sovereign debt distress, or permanent crater darkness—that persists continuously or reappears across extended timeframes.
definition_hindi: किसी भौतिक स्थिति, संरचनात्मक कठिनाई अथवा बार-बार उत्पन्न होने वाली सामाजिक या आर्थिक समस्या (जैसे लगान-वसूली की विफलता, संप्रभु ऋण संकट या क्रेटर का स्थायी अंधकार) का वर्णन करने वाला विशेषण, जो दीर्घकाल तक निरंतर बनी रहती है या पुनः प्रकट होती है।

hindi_equivalents_etymology.चिरस्थायी: Sanskrit tatsama compound चिर + स्थायी (cira + sthāyī, 'long-lasting + standing/enduring'), attested in Hindwi
hindi_equivalents_etymology.स्थायी: Sanskrit tatsama adjective स्थायी (sthāyī, 'standing, enduring'), attested in Shabdkosh
hindi_equivalents_etymology.बारहमासी: Native Hindi compound बारह + मास (bārah + mās, 'twelve + months'), attested in Hindi Shabdasagar Part 5, p. 147
hindi_equivalents_etymology.परेनीअल: Devanagari phonetic transliteration of English perennial, attested in Shabdkosh

equivalence_mapping.usage_status: Attested in Hindwi, Shabdkosh, and the TestPYQ competitive-exam vocabulary list; conveys long-term endurance, though carries neutral-to-laudatory tone in scholarly Hindi prose
Attested in Shabdkosh; fits continuous physical conditions (such as permanent shadow) better than intermittent recurrence
Attested in Shabdkosh and the TestPYQ UPSC CSAT glossary for recurring problems, though primarily grounded in twelve-month agricultural and hydrological cycles
Attested in Shabdkosh, but carries strong positive connotations ('evergreen/ever-fresh') and causes pragmatic distortion in negative collocations such as perennial problem

syntactic_patterns: attributive adjective before abstract, socioeconomic, or physical nouns (perennial problem, perennial challenge, perennial shadow)

hindi.case: Invariable across direct and oblique cases
hindi.adjective_agreement: Invariable (अविकारी); does not inflect across masculine (संकट, अंधकार) or feminine (समस्या, चुनौती) head nouns
syntactic_patterns: attributive pre-nominal modifier before abstract or physical nouns (चिरस्थायी समस्या, चिरस्थायी चुनौती, स्थायी अंधकार)

register_and_pragmatics.academic_register: Historical, economic, and general academic discourse
register_and_pragmatics.connotation: Neutral-to-laudatory for चिरस्थायी in archival prose; strongly positive for सदाबहार (making सदाबहार inappropriate for negative problems)
cultural_nuances: चिरस्थायी is reported to describe dignified historical achievements in scholarly Hindi prose (an example from Ramchandra Shukla's preface on Hindisamay is cited in the research notes but not listed in the references), so using it for negative socioeconomic problems requires careful contextual framing.
usage_restrictions: Never use सदाबहार (evergreen/ever-popular) for negative collocations like perennial problem or perennial debt-trap.
Restrict सदानीरा strictly to hydrology (S2) and बहुवर्षी strictly to botany (S1).

linguistic_analysis.morphosyntax: English perennial functions as an attributive adjective modifying abstract or physical nouns (perennial problem, perennial shadow). Hindi चिरस्थायी, स्थायी, and बारहमासी are morphologically invariable adjectives (अविकारी विशेषण) that do not inflect for gender, number, or case; postpositions attach to the modified head noun.
linguistic_analysis.pragmatic_constraint: Negative English collocations (perennial problem, perennial challenge, perennial debt-trap) clash pragmatically with positive Hindi adjectives like सदाबहार, requiring neutral-to-formal equivalents (चिरस्थायी, स्थायी, बारहमासी).

conceptual_analysis.core_distinction: Designates long-term persistence or chronic recurrence of structural conditions, difficulties, or physical states across extended periods.
conceptual_analysis.domain_boundary: Covers general, historical, socioeconomic, and physical persistence (S3); distinct from multi-year plant biology (S1), year-round water flow (S2), regular government staffing (S4), and timeless philosophical doctrines (S5).

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both denote enduring persistence across extended time without rapid cessation.
pairwise_comparison.difference: चिरस्थायी emphasizes long-continued endurance over time ('long-lasting'), whereas स्थायी denotes fixed permanence or stability, making स्थायी especially apt for invariant physical conditions like permanent lunar crater shadow.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Moderate; interchangeable in general persistence contexts, though स्थायी is more precise for unchanging physical states.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both appear in competitive-exam vocabulary lists (such as TestPYQ for UPSC CSAT) to gloss recurring issues.
pairwise_comparison.difference: चिरस्थायी belongs to formal academic and administrative prose, whereas बारहमासी ('twelve-monthly') retains a concrete seasonal/agricultural metaphor.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Moderate in general socioeconomic writing; prefer चिरस्थायी or स्थायी in formal academic prose.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Minimal; linked only via broad bilingual dictionary entries (Shabdkosh) that group positive longevity terms together.
pairwise_comparison.difference: चिरस्थायी carries neutral-to-formal durability, whereas सदाबहार carries positive celebratory connotations ('evergreen/ever-fresh').
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Not interchangeable in negative socioeconomic collocations.
